input.title: Unrecognised card purchase
input.request: I want H&V to investigate a posted card purchase at Fern & Finch Books for £38.40 on 14 July 2025, which I do not recognise, and tell me how I can safely protect my card.

events.text: I show a posted card purchase at Fern & Finch Books for £38.40 on 14 July 2025. Its appearance in your transaction list does not establish who made it.

summary: The customer asked the bank to investigate a posted £38.40 card purchase at Fern & Finch Books on 14 July 2025 that they don't recognise, and to advise how to protect their card. The desk registered an investigation request with the card team, after refusing a preliminary ask to the card system because this was a register request. The bank's records only show the payment posted, which doesn't establish who made it. Nothing was blocked or reversed and no outcome has been decided, so the investigation itself is left with the card team, and the customer was given general card-protection tips and told they can ask for the card to be blocked or replaced.

- If you think your card details have been compromised, ask us to block or replace the card. Tell us here and we'll pass that instruction on.
- Never share your PIN, full card number or passwords with anyone. The bank will never ask you for your PIN or password.
